notes: Discovery checked 2026-11-09. This is an initial source-discovery inventory; coverage is not claimed complete.

2026-11-09 extraction pass: model numbers, date-introduced statements, capacities and navigation interfaces were parsed where explicitly present in all 37 iPod records. Records remain partial: the source material is Apple's model-identification page, not a complete technical-specification archive.

2026-11-10 scope clarification: the 37 current iPod records are based on Apple's official 'Identify your iPod model' page (https://support.apple.com/en-ie/103823), not 37 separate technical-specification pages. Each record currently preserves one concise identification section with model/date, capacity, navigation interface and/or description where Apple supplies it. These are verified identification records, not complete technical-specification records.

2026-11-10 repository audit: all 37 inventory source_file references resolve to existing archived files in the current Git tree. This confirms archive-path presence only, not the accuracy or reachability of every source URL.

2026-11-10 source-discovery correction: the current 37 records all point to Apple's model-identification page, but a web search found separate official Apple technical-specification pages for several representative models. The previous assumption that no dedicated pages were available is therefore too broad; a model-by-model source migration is required before iPod can be considered complete.

Confirmed official technical-specification page examples: iPod touch (7th generation), support article 111961; iPod shuffle (4th generation), support article 112422; iPod nano (7th generation), support article 112039; iPod classic 120GB, support article 112321; iPod classic 160GB (Late 2009), support article 112601. These URLs were discovered through Apple Support search results and still need matching archived HTML before changing record source mappings.

2026-11-10 field audit: capacity consistency check covered all 37 iPod records. One omission was found and corrected: iPod classic (September 2007) explicitly supports 80 GB and 160 GB; both are now present in product.storage_options and normalized_specifications.capacity_statements.

2026-11-10 field audit: all 37 records' product model-number lists were compared with their normalized model-number/date evidence. One discrepancy was corrected in iPod touch (2nd generation): the second identifier is A1319 (China mainland only), not a duplicate A1288.

2026-11-10 web discovery: stored five exact official Apple technical-specification URLs as related-source leads. None has yet replaced the primary source mapping because matching raw HTML archives are not yet present in the repository.

2026-11-11 provenance correction: all 37 product records now cite the single shared archived file apple_remaining_extraction/technical_specs_html/ipod-index.html and the actual page title, 'Identify your iPod model - Apple Support (IE)'. Each is marked partially_verified because this page provides model identification evidence, not a full technical specification sheet. Earlier per-model HTML filenames were copies of the same general page and are no longer cited as separate sources.

2026-11-11 source migration: five archived model-specific technical-specification pages are now mapped as primary sources for eight iPod records (including the matching 4th-generation shuffle and 7th-generation nano refresh variants). Each record's detailed source sections are extracted from its model-specific technical page. Model number/introduction-date identity evidence remains cross-checked against the shared identification page at https://support.apple.com/en-ie/103823.

record_audit.source_policy: Official Apple iPod identification page and preserved record text; no absent specifications inferred.
completed: Extracted explicit model numbers, model-number/introduction-date pairs, capacity options and navigation interface where present.
Set model_year and year_introduced only when the source text provided one unambiguous introduction year; multi-year combined records remain unset.
Attached source-section provenance to normalized fields and preserved original wording.
Reviewed all 37 existing iPod JSON records and retained their original official Apple identification text.

Inspected representative iPod touch, classic, nano, shuffle and Click Wheel records and confirmed their preserved text is from Apple's official model-identification page, not dedicated technical-specification pages.
Checked every working_scope source_file path against the current Git repository tree on 2026-11-10; all 37 referenced archive paths exist.

Outside-source discovery confirmed that dedicated Apple technical-specification pages exist for representative iPod models, including iPod touch (7th generation), iPod nano (7th generation), iPod shuffle (4th generation), and multiple iPod classic capacity/year variants.

Compared capacity statements against product.storage_options and normalized capacity fields across all 37 iPod records; corrected the September 2007 iPod classic record to retain both 80 GB and 160 GB capacities.

Compared product.model_numbers with normalized model-number/date pairs across all 37 iPod records; corrected the iPod touch (2nd generation) duplicate A1288 entry to A1319 and retained the China-mainland-only qualifier.

Corrected all 37 iPod records to cite the shared archived identification page and its actual title; downgraded status from content_verified to partially_verified to avoid overstating technical-specification verification.

Archived five official Apple Ireland iPod technical-specification pages with SHA-256 sidecar metadata and replaced identification-page-only primary source mappings for eight applicable records; extracted the visible technical-specification sections into each record.
remaining: Find and archive model-specific Apple technical-specification pages for remaining iPod models where available.
Use the identification page as secondary evidence for model numbers and introduction dates where the technical-specification page omits them.
Verify all 37 model/date/capacity variants individually, keeping distinct iPod classic capacity/year variants separate.
